description: The donut chart visually represents the composition of the Darija Open Dataset Version 2, breaking down its contents into six distinct categories, each labeled with a specific data type and corresponding numerical value. The largest segment, colored yellow, represents “Translated Sentences” with 45,387 entries, followed by the light green “Pending Translations” segment at 43,000. The blue-gray “Extra + Augmented Data” segment accounts for 30,000 entries, while the orange-brown “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” segment contains 23,108 entries. Two much smaller segments are also shown: the dark purple “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” and the reddish-orange “Moroccan Names,” both of which are visually minimal and lack visible numerical labels, suggesting they constitute a negligible portion of the total dataset. The chart includes a legend on the right side matching each color to its category, and the numerical values are displayed directly within their respective segments, emphasizing the relative scale of each component in the dataset’s structure.
